name: FillingType
summary: This EA is a utility tool that demonstrates and tests the different order filling types available in MQL5 (FOK, IOC, Return). It does not implement any trading strategy but rather provides a framework for understanding how filling modes work with different brokers and symbols.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个实用工具，用于演示和测试MQL5中可用的不同订单填充类型（FOK、IOC、Return）。它不实现任何交易策略，而是提供一个框架来理解不同经纪商和品种的填充模式工作方式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不包含任何交易策略，它是一个纯工具性质的程序。其主要功能是枚举和测试MQL5平台上订单的填充类型，包括FOK（全部成交或取消）、IOC（立即成交否则取消）和Return（退货模式）。入场条件方面，该程序不基于任何技术指标或价格信号开仓，而是根据用户选择的填充类型提交测试订单。出场条件不适用，因为该工具不管理持仓。仓位管理不涉及，程序仅用于检测经纪商支持的填充模式。资金管理方面没有相关逻辑，因为这不是一个交易型EA。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy; it is a purely utility-based program. Its primary function is to enumerate and test the order filling types available on the MQL5 platform, including FOK (Fill or Kill), IOC (Immediate or Cancel), and Return mode. Regarding entry conditions, the program does not open positions based on any technical indicators or price signals; instead, it submits test orders based on the user-selected filling type. Exit conditions are not applicable since this tool does not manage positions. Position sizing is not involved as the program is only used to detect filling modes supported by the broker. There is no money management logic since this is not a trading EA.

pros: 帮助开发者快速识别经纪商支持的填充类型，避免因填充类型不匹配导致下单失败
代码简洁明了，适合MQL5初学者理解订单填充机制
实用性强，在切换经纪商或交易新品种时可快速验证兼容性
pros_en: Helps developers quickly identify filling types supported by the broker, avoiding order failures due to mismatched filling types
Clean and straightforward code, suitable for MQL5 beginners to understand order filling mechanisms
Highly practical for quickly verifying compatibility when switching brokers or trading new symbols
cons: 功能过于单一，仅检测填充类型，缺乏完整的交易逻辑
没有提供批量测试所有填充类型的自动化功能，需要手动逐个测试
缺少错误处理的详细反馈，测试失败时无法明确区分是填充类型不支持还是其他原因
cons_en: Functionality is too narrow, only detecting filling types without any complete trading logic
No automated batch testing for all filling types; requires manual testing one by one
Lacks detailed error handling feedback; when a test fails, it is unclear whether the filling type is unsupported or another issue caused the failure
improvements: 增加自动遍历所有填充类型并输出检测报告的功能，提高测试效率
添加详细的错误日志记录，区分填充类型不支持和其他下单错误
增加对交易所品种的填充类型检测支持，扩展适用范围
improvements_en: Add automated traversal of all filling types with a detection report output to improve testing efficiency
Add detailed error logging to distinguish between unsupported filling types and other order placement errors
Add support for exchange symbol filling type detection to expand the scope of applicability

risk_points: 可能在实盘测试时意外提交真实订单，建议在模拟账户中使用
缺少对当前账户交易权限的检查，可能在只读账户上报错
risk_points_en: May accidentally submit real orders during live testing; recommend using on demo accounts first
Lacks checking of current account trading permissions, which may cause errors on read-only accounts

summary_en: This EA is a utility tool that demonstrates and tests the different order filling types available in MQL5 (FOK, IOC, Return). It does not implement any trading strategy but rather provides a framework for understanding how filling modes work with different brokers and symbols.
